label: b2-fixtures-R4
text:
Node fixtures-R4 (7 of 12): write test cases for R4: at least two that break the rule, as files in /opt/enforce/fixtures/R4/flag, and at least two that follow it, in /opt/enforce/fixtures/R4/pass. Each is one file of what the check reads (An assistant response or a message from the agent. Where: the agent's reply exists only inside the agent framework: its hook at the end of the turn gets it, and its transcript keeps it (a file in the agent's home)); make them like what the agent may really write.
Done when: /opt/enforce/fixtures/R4/flag and /opt/enforce/fixtures/R4/pass each hold at least two files. The harness checks this when you reply.
